colormap.name: sst_diverging_dark
colormap.alpha_rule: Transparent (alpha = 0) for |anom| <= 0.25 °C; smooth ramp to fully opaque (alpha = 255) for |anom| >= 1.0 °C; land and missing/sea-ice cells transparent.

method: Monthly sea surface temperature minus 1991–2020 monthly climatology from NOAA ERSST v6 (2° grid), nearest-neighbor mapped to 720×360 equirectangular with Natural Earth 10m land, missing/sea-ice, and near-normal water (|anom| <= 0.25 °C) transparent (smooth fade to full opacity by |anom| >= 1.0 °C). Niño-3.4 area mean (5°S–5°N, 170°W–120°W) cosine-latitude weighted; chapters follow NOAA CPC RONI.
